questions.question: In Spring MVC, which component receives every incoming request first and routes it to the right controller?
questions.explanation: The DispatcherServlet is the front controller. All requests enter through it, and it finds the matching controller method.

questions.question: Which class should hold business rules such as 'a member can borrow at most 3 books'?
questions.explanation: Controllers stay thin and handle web details. Business rules belong in the service so any endpoint can reuse them.

questions.question: A @RestController method @GetMapping("/books") returns List.of(new Book(1, "Salt and Stars")) where Book is record Book(int id, String title). What is the response body?
questions.explanation: The message converter (Jackson) writes the returned list of records as a JSON array of objects.

questions.question: The controller prints "Controller" and then calls a service method that prints "Service". What appears in the console for one request?
questions.explanation: The controller runs first because the DispatcherServlet calls it, and the controller then calls the service.

questions.question: The main class is in com.pageturn.library. A @RestController is in com.pageturn.web. The app starts but GET /books returns 404. What is wrong?
options: GET requests are not allowed in Spring MVC
The controller is outside the packages that component scan covers
Jackson is missing from the project
questions.explanation: Component scan covers the main class's package and below, so com.pageturn.web is never scanned and the controller is not registered.
